tasks.goal:
Run a cold adversarial review on all new/modified scripts built in this session. For each script:

1. Read the script in full.
2. Verify py_compile passes.
3. Run a smoke test of the primary subcommand.
4. Check for: (a) dead code never called, (b) claimed features not present, (c) imports that will fail at runtime, (d) hardcoded paths that don't exist on disk, (e) functions that reference undefined variables.
